confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings; no web search was used for prices. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain. Beer assumes a 330 ml draft. Wine and cocktail were set from Madrid price levels and checked against typical beer ratios. Remembered 2024-2025 prices were brought forward to July 2026 for hospitality price growth. USD values assume EUR/USD near 1.16 from memory, not a checked rate; a 5% EUR/USD move shifts all USD anchors about 5%. FX 0.6955 (2026-10-15) comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page (14 Oct shown as 0.7002). I did not open that page, and one result warned its date label may not match its contents, so confirm on the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned by comparison with Barcelona and Lisbon as similar Iberian and Southern European capitals, adjusted for Madrid's typical restaurant and accommodation levels; no live city-price lookup was performed.
